purpose: Feasibility of a historically aligned HESI baseline. No new national share computed.

published_r24_untouched.costs: September 2026 Thrifty + FY2026 HUD replacement rent + one-car $7,264.70/year

2024.income_question: money income in the past 12 months
2024.rolling_limitation: A household interviewed in month m reports approximately m-12 through m-1. January 2024 interviews are mostly 2023 income; December 2024 interviews are mostly 2024 income. ADJINC does not convert the series into a September snapshot.
2024.kind: observed survey microdata, not a nowcast

2021.note: 2010 PUMA definitions. Must not be joined to 2020-PUMA FY2026 puma_fmr_screened.csv.

workbooks_on_disk_not_in_frozen_extract.usda-thriftyplan-june2021-sept2026.xlsx: Thrifty 21-Pres sheet starts June 2021; 2022-2023 monthly TFP extractable. Not in source_2024_2026.csv.

usda_food.kind: modeled USDA Thrifty Food Plan prices, not observed grocery spending
gaps: 2022 and 2023 months not in frozen CSV
Alaska/Hawaii not used by joint engine (mainland applied nationally)

current_joint_table.fmr_vintage: revised FY2026 (effective 2026-05-21; FY starts 2025-10-01; covers September 2026)
current_joint_table.kind: modeled replacement rent, not ACS GRNTP/SMOCP

hud_housing.fiscal_vs_calendar: HUD FY2024 = 2023-10-01 to 2024-09-30. Calendar 2024 costs would need an explicit FY2024-only or Oct-switch FY2024/FY2025 rule.

current_joint_input.assignment: constant one car on every included household
current_joint_input.reference: September 2026 EIA U.S. regular mean $4.35475/gal; 12,000 miles; 32 mpg; non-fuel items hypothetical

missing_for_2024: EIA weekly U.S. regular gasoline for calendar 2024 or a named 2024 month
2024 insurance/maintenance/registration if those are to be re-priced rather than held as labeled assumptions
transportation.kind: modeled scenario, not ACS vehicle ownership or expenditures
